# Independent Godot curved membrane reference

`embedded_membrane_reference.json` is generated by
`godot/tests/test_fem_reference.gd` with the pinned Godot4.7.2. It includes the
generator/material source hashes and full-precision numerical arrays, no patient
data. The synthetic curved capsule has a real finite material incision but its
current connected-star basis still has217controls and396material cells; it is
not a completed capsulotomy or a crack-opening mechanics proof.

The stored deformed-control state, unit test stiffnesses, energy and analytic
gradient come from the independently implemented GDScript evaluator. Native tests
also compute local derivatives with finite differences and a NumPy oracle. Fixed
flags are explicit JSON integers (36rim controls), not a Godot PackedByteArray
string. The implicit candidate tests start from original rest plus a0.0005center
prediction, with the rim fixed. No surgical instrument, contact, fluid or actual
operator time sequence is included.

2026-11-04 precise-cut-map change: regenerated with pinned engine after the
optional supplied-weight support API was added. The entire numerical payload,
including energy, gradients, cells and masses, compares exactly equal to the
previous fixture after excluding source hashes. Only the Support source hash
